build_SO3_Embedding: create an SO3_Embedding to initialize irreps embeddings with specified lmax and num_channels
build_SO3_LinearV2: build an SO3_LinearV2 module to apply equivariant linear transformations on SO3 embeddings
build_SO3_Rotation: build an SO3_Rotation module to compute Wigner-D matrices from 3x3 rotation matrices
build_SO3_Grid: build an SO3_Grid module to transform irreps to and from grid representations
build_CoefficientMappingModule: build a CoefficientMappingModule to map spherical harmonic coefficients between l and m indexing
